title: RQP patch envelope (rqp/1, HTTP)
description: Normative text: docs/engineering/protocol/manifest-patch.md section 2. Since H-104 the envelope is next_revision and the operations; the client computes the block hash of each content and checks next_revision (section 2.4, step 7). Unknown members, also the members of the envelope before H-104 (type, protocol, base_revision, template_revision, op, format, sha256), make the envelope invalid. The schema does not check rules that need more than one value or the client state: block ids known, unique and in document order, the next_revision recomputation, content rules, byte sizes, duplicate member names.

operations.description: rqp/1 has one operation: replace the content of a block (H-47). The operation has no op member (H-104); a new operation needs a new capability and a new envelope form.

content.description: New block content. maxLength counts code points; the client also checks the UTF-8 byte length (maxBlockBytes).
